status: built and verified on Ubuntu 26.04 x86_64 (packaging/build-linux-payload.sh); not yet shipped inside a Counterpart .deb/AppImage - apps/linux owns that wiring via RECONSTRUCTION_PAYLOAD
target: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS x86_64. Explicit system baseline the payload may resolve from the host: ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, libc.so.6, libm.so.6, libdl.so.2, libpthread.so.0, librt.so.1, libutil.so.1, libresolv.so.2 (glibc 2.43 core). Every other library of every shipped binary must resolve inside the payload; the build fails otherwise (a build-host /usr/lib resolution is a failure, not a pass).

layout.bin/linux-reconstruct: relocatable launcher: bundled python/bin/python3 + tool/reconstruct.py, defaults SCAN_TO_MAKE_OPENMVS_DIR and SCAN_TO_MAKE_COLMAP to the payload
layout.tool/: tools/linux-reconstruct source at the build commit (git archive)
layout.python/: standalone CPython with usd-core + Pillow installed from pinned wheels
layout.colmap-root/: Ubuntu .deb closure extracted with dpkg -x (downloaded, never installed)
layout.openmvs/: InterfaceCOLMAP, DensifyPointCloud, ReconstructMesh from the official binary zip
layout.lib/: GCC runtime libraries (libgomp, libstdc++, libgcc_s) from the same .deb closure
layout.licenses/: notices extracted from the exact shipped artifacts, Debian copyright files, OpenMVS license + corresponding source tarball, build-check.json

components.name: COLMAP (Ubuntu package colmap 3.12.6-4) + shared-library closure
components.version: 3.12.6-4 (Ubuntu 26.04 archive at build time; exact .deb versions recorded in the payload's licenses/debian/)
components.licence: COLMAP BSD-3-Clause; each closure library under its Debian copyright file shipped in licenses/debian/
components.acquire: Exact pins (name, version, .deb SHA-256) in packaging/colmap-packages.txt; apt-get download of name=version, each .deb hash-verified by package metadata, dpkg -x into colmap-root (downloaded, never installed). Includes libposelib, which the colmap package links but does not declare.
components.verify: bin/colmap help -> COLMAP 3.12.6, plus the strict closure proof in build-linux-payload.sh

components.name: OpenMVS official Ubuntu binaries
components.role: Dense point cloud + mesh, invoked as separate processes

binaryArchive.note: This hash is the official prebuilt BINARY zip (an earlier draft wrongly called it a source archive).

components.runtimeLibraries: libgomp/libstdc++/libgcc_s from the .deb closure (lib/), glibc from the supported host

components.name: CPython standalone (astral-sh/python-build-standalone)
components.licence: PSF + bundled-library notices (licenses/python-LICENSE.txt from the shipped tree)

components.name: usd-core wheel
components.licence: As shipped in the exact wheel: METADATA LicenseRef-TOST-1.0 with LICENSE.txt (OpenUSD's TOST terms cover Apache-2.0-based terms plus third-party notices; the composite expression in the Mac audit - TOST/MIT/BSD/Apache/BSL/Apple sample code - describes the same wheel family). Full texts in licenses/usd_core/.

components.name: Pillow wheel
components.licence: As shipped in the exact wheel: METADATA License-Expression MIT-CMU, LICENSE file in licenses/pillow/.
components.role: Image handling for companion helpers that share this Python on Linux; the reconstruction tool itself parses headers with the standard library.

readiness.check: bin/linux-reconstruct check --mode samples|qualify prints one JSON line {ok, toolVersion, versions} and exits 0 only when the closure runs (30s bound in the companion)
readiness.capability: companion capabilities.reconstructionReviewV1 requires this check to pass; results are cached per packaged BUILD-ID (mtime fallback for unpackaged checkouts), failures re-probed after 30s and never cached as success; the probe runs with the companion-supplied environment and drains stderr; check imports the exact USD modules qualification loads (Gf, Usd, UsdGeom, UsdUtils, Vt)
readiness.mac: No separate Mac closure: qualify reuses the audited Mac payload Python (CPython 3.12 + usd-core 26.8 + Pillow 13 in apps/mac/distribution.json) via the relocatable in-repo launcher; check --mode qualify is the Mac readiness probe

verification: packaging/build-linux-payload.sh OUT (ends with env -i relocated check)
